formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit IF-THEN Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute check on C3.1 + C3.2.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can read and write IF-THEN code.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can read and write IF-THEN code.
header.character_watermark: Inspector If in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: Underline the IF and circle the THEN in this statement: IF the number is even, THEN clap.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. A single statement.

image_placeholders.description: A single IF-THEN statement in B&W, ~6in x 1in. Pre-printed: 'IF the number is even, THEN clap.'. Header 'Find IF and THEN:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_FIND: keywords (if, then) name what the slot asks for.

prompts.answer_key: IF the number is even underlined; THEN clap circled.

prompts.prompt: Trace this code: IF >10 THEN BIG; ELSE SMALL. Input: 7. What's the outcome?

image_placeholders.description: A trace box in B&W, ~6in x 1.5in. Pre-printed: 'Code: IF >10 THEN BIG; ELSE SMALL. Input: 7. Outcome: ___'. Header 'Trace:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_TRACE: keywords (trace, outcome) name what the box asks for.

prompts.prompt: Write a two-branch IF-THEN code that sorts numbers as multiples of 5 or not.

image_placeholders.description: A two-branch slot pair in B&W, ~6in x 1.5in. 'IF ___, THEN ___.' and 'IF NOT ___, THEN ___.'. Header 'Write Code:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_WRITE: keywords (write, code) name what the slots ask for.

prompts.answer_key: Open. Sample: IF multiple of 5, THEN clap. IF NOT multiple of 5, THEN stomp.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, or TRY AGAIN.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Three faces in a row labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, and TRY AGAIN.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row in B&W. Smile labelled GOT IT, neutral labelled ALMOST, frown labelled TRY AGAIN.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q4_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Score: find correct + trace correct + code correct = ready for Lesson 4.

reflection_sheet.title: My Detective Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Inspector If with a Junior Conditional Coder certificate. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Conditional Coder? Circle one.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. Three star-rating ovals.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Coder!'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 5-row YES/NO table in B&W. Rows: 'I read IF-THEN statements', 'I wrote IF-THEN code with two branches', 'I traced code with inputs', 'I altered code', 'I made a capstone project'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

options: I wrote IF-THEN code with two branches

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE IF-THEN task?

image_placeholders.description: Five icons in B&W: read statement, write code, trace input, alter code, capstone project. Each ~1in x 1in with selection bubble.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (icons) name the five options.

prompts.visual_layout: Lower-middle. Three tricky-moment cards in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: 'Two branches', 'Tracing inputs', 'Altering code'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: 'More IF-THENs', 'Loops', 'Real coding'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at end of Lesson 5 after the certificate ceremony.
